run_benchmark_dataformats: run the benchmark script with --root flag to compare BOP dataset format I/O performance
benchmark_wds_sequential: benchmark WebDataset sequential access timing by reading samples from a shard tar file
benchmark_wds_random: benchmark WebDataset random access timing by loading image data from specific shard keys
benchmark_imwise: benchmark imagewise format random access timing by loading image data from individual files
benchmark_scenewise: benchmark scenewise format random access timing by loading image data from scene directories
